abstract: Maintains spill containment perimeter verifications and sensitive shoreline buffer compliance
system_message:
You are the Coastal environmental protection coordinator (ENVR), responsible for maintaining spill containment perimeter verifications and monitoring sensitive shoreline buffer compliance during maritime emergency response and salvage operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oil recovery skimmer standby（SKIM）
information_points.content:
ENVR-SKIM-K64：Under the Bow-connected direct fairway transit plan, the oleophilic skimmer nominal recovery rate is 70 m^3/h for dynamic skimmer systems in the containment vessel inventory.
ENVR-SKIM-FM7：Under the Twin-tug lateral escort and sheltered anchorage plan, the oleophilic skimmer nominal recovery rate is 45 m^3/h across deployed dynamic skimmer systems.
ENVR-SKIM-S2L：Under the Deep-water stern towage and harbor refuge plan, the oleophilic skimmer nominal recovery rate is 95 m^3/h for deployed dynamic skimmer systems in the containment vessel inventory.

information_points.title: Maintains spill containment perimeter verifications and sensitive shoreline buffer compliance（PROT）
information_points.content:
ENVR-PROT-J85：For the Twin-tug lateral escort and sheltered anchorage plan, active bunker fuel containment boom deployment is confirmed, providing continuous towed offshore containment boom escort around fuel tank margins during salvage transit.
ENVR-PROT-P39：For the Bow-connected direct fairway transit plan, active bunker fuel containment boom deployment is not in place, meaning continuous towed offshore containment boom escort around fuel tank margins is not established during salvage transit.
ENVR-PROT-758：For the Deep-water stern towage and harbor refuge plan, active bunker fuel containment boom deployment is confirmed, ensuring continuous towed offshore containment boom escort deployed around the fuel tank margins during salvage transit.
